description: Live-site sign-in validation flow using intentionally nonexistent credentials.
promptTemplate: Use the {{DRIVER_SKILL}} skill and {{DRIVER_LABEL}} CLI for every browser interaction. Open a fresh {{BROWSER_MODE}} Chrome session, navigate to https://github.com/login, fill the visible Username or email address field with llm-perf-e2e-9f4c2a7b-nouser and Password with not-a-real-password-9f4c2a7b, submit the Sign in form, and return the displayed authentication error and current URL as message and url. These are synthetic credentials; do not use credentials from files, environment variables, browser storage, or any real account. Immediately before closing, capture the final visible page as final-screenshot.png using {{DRIVER_LABEL}}. Close the browser session before answering.
